actions.action: Inspect leaves, joints and stems closely with a magnifier or macro lens for pests
Slide plant out of pot and check roots for rot
If mealybugs are found, dab them with a cotton swab dipped in isopropyl alcohol, repeating over a few weeks
Alternatively apply a systemic insecticide like imidacloprid
Trim brown leaves with clean scissors
Take and share a sharper close-up of white flecks or roots

reason: The answer blames treatment damage and only lists pests as a possibility, so the diagnosis is partial. Alcohol treatment appears only as a conditional step, so the advice is partial. Telling the owner to stop spraying alcohol for one to two weeks would delay control of an active infestation, so it is harmful.
